description: Expected signals for QD7 Phase 3 — wf-fix-probe-static-deprecated.sh (only live bash probe in QD7; covers 3 signal categories: deprecated_api, deprecated_css, deprecated_pkg). 4/5 audit-spec probes are SPEC_GAP (runtime-only or D15 broken heredoc).
fingerprint_note: D17: probe uses 6-token SHA256 input 'QD7|file|line|probe_id|signal_type|label' vs signal-emit.md 5-token spec. Format output is still sha256:<64-hex>.

signals.note: document.execCommand('copy') on line with el.select() → HIGH deprecated_api. Regex: document\.execCommand\(\s*['"]copy['"]. Replacement: navigator.clipboard.writeText
componentWillMount() React class lifecycle → HIGH deprecated_api. Regex: componentWillMount\b. Replacement: useEffect or componentDidMount
zoom: 1.5 CSS property (at least 1 match) → LOW deprecated_css. Regex: ^[[:space:]]*zoom[[:space:]]*:. Replacement: transform: scale()
new Buffer(data) Node.js API → CRITICAL deprecated_api (uninitialized memory risk). Regex: new Buffer\(. Replacement: Buffer.alloc / Buffer.from
moment package in dependencies → MEDIUM deprecated_pkg. cdg_flags: ['CDG-DEPS-DOWN'] (D10). Replacement: date-fns or dayjs
TN-QD7-001: uses navigator.clipboard.writeText — no document.execCommand pattern → 0 deprecated_api signals from this file
TN-QD7-002: uses useEffect hook — no componentWillMount/componentWillReceiveProps/componentWillUpdate pattern → 0 deprecated_api signals
TN-QD7-003: uses transform: scale() — no zoom: CSS property pattern → 0 deprecated_css signals. overflow-wrap: anywhere (not word-break: break-word) → 0 additional signals
TN-QD7-004: uses Buffer.alloc() and Buffer.from() — no new Buffer( pattern → 0 deprecated_api signals
TN-QD7-005: negative/package.json uses date-fns + axios — neither is in deprecated packages list (moment/request/node-uuid/jade/babel-preset-es2015/tslint/core-js@2) → 0 deprecated_pkg signals
